shortDefinition.en: A kelvin-scale description of a light source's color, distinct from the result of compensating for an assumed source in a camera.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 以开尔文表示的光源颜色属性，与相机根据假设光源进行补偿后的画面结果不同。

en: Increasing the camera's Kelvin setting does not universally mean the resulting image becomes warmer; distinguish source color from compensation.
zh-cn: 相机 K 值调高不总是意味着画面更暖；应区分光源颜色与相机的补偿。

example.en: The X-T5's white-balance menu provides 2500–10000 K selection; this is a documented camera setting range, not a definition of every possible light source.
example.zh-cn: X-T5 白平衡菜单提供 2500–10000 K 选择；这是该机设置范围，不是所有光源可能色温的定义。

sources.title: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING (Still Photography) — FUJIFILM X-T5 Owner’s Manual
sources.supports: Kelvin source-color descriptions, the X-T5 setting range, and white-balance adjustment.
